metadata.name: ManualAuthorization
metadata.description: This API is used to post manual auth.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: AdminNumber
request_fields.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

request_fields.name: AccountNumber
request_fields.description: Account number of account holder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardNumber
request_fields.description: Card number of account holder. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXX Example:7314145404 Allowable Values: 19

request_fields.name: CardExpirationDate
request_fields.description: Expiration date of card. Valid Values: 0-9 Format:YYMM Example:2012 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: ProcessingCode
request_fields.description: This Tag refer the Processing code Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXX Example:1234

request_fields.name: TransactionAmount
request_fields.description: Amount of Transaction Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:200.00

request_fields.name: MerchantName
request_fields.description: Name of the Merchant Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:ABC LLC Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: CardAcceptorNameLocation
request_fields.description: Merchant name and location Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: CardAcceptorIDCode
request_fields.description: Merchant Number. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896541236 Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: CardAcceptorTerminalID
request_fields.description: Merchant's Terminal Number. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:1236547896541236 Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: TransmissionDateTime
request_fields.description: Time of transaction. Valid Values:0-9 Format:MM/DD/YYYY HH:MM:SS Example:12/11/2019 11:00:00

request_fields.name: CoreAuthTranIdRev
request_fields.description: Transaction id received in response of manual Auth API which is used to locate the transaction to be reversed.

request_fields.name: PreAuthorizationAging
request_fields.description: Number to signify when the preauth will be aged off Numeric value. Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: PreAuthorizationAgingFrame
request_fields.description: Signifies the time to age off the Preauthorization i.e. Mins,Hours,days etc. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: ResponseCode
request_fields.description: Response code to be stamped on Transaction, if in input then used for response of declined or approved transaction. Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: ApprovalCode
request_fields.description: Approval Code of a transaction Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:632563 Allowable Values: 6

request_fields.name: ClientName
request_fields.description: Specifies the client name for which the API is used. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: InvoiceNumber
request_fields.description: User entered identification number captured in request and echoed in response. Allowable Values: 40

request_fields.name: TransactionDescription
request_fields.description: Any informatory text user can enter in this field. Allowable Values: 16

request_fields.name: CardSequenceNumber
request_fields.description: Physical Card order can be uniquely identified by combination of Admin Number and Card Sequence Number. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1

request_fields.name: CreditPlanNumber
request_fields.description: Signifies the CPM on which the Transaction needs to be posted ,in response the CPM where transaction was posted. Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: TransactionType
request_fields.description: Type of transaction should be text describing the type of transaction which can be provided by Client Valid Values: 0100: Purchase Auth or Pre-Auth is a Pre-Authorization that places a hold on your customer's credit card for a specified dollar amount based on a projected sale amount. This guarantees you access to their credit limit for the specified amount instead of actually debiting funds from the cardholder it just put a temporary hold on the funds that lasts for a particulate time period depending on the configuration. 0220 Completion: Completion Matches the Pre-Authorization and releases then fund put on hold and posts the actual transaction for which the purchase is done.The Completion is matched to Pre-Auth on the basis of CardNumber, Approval code, Merchant details, Date time of transaction etc.If a Completion request is initiated without a valid Approval code(no valid Pre-Auth present) then it will post an independent purchase of the specified amount forcefully on the Card. 0420 Reversal: This process is used to negate a transaction which is done on a cardholder's account. This can be used to negate any transaction based on matching data like Card Number , date time, Transaction id generated for the original transaction. Allowable Values: 8

request_fields.name: MerchantType
request_fields.description: MerchantType MerchantType Valid Values: 5812 Allowable Values: 4

request_fields.name: AmexCardRequest
request_fields.description: Through this tag system identifies whether the card number belongs to AMEX. Valid Values: 0 = No, 1 = Yes Example: 0

request_fields.name: TransactionCurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency code corresponding to the Transaction Amount. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX Example:840 Allowable Values: 3

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: ResponseCode
children.description: Response code generated by Corecard application in transaction processing. Allowable Values: 8

children.name: ApprovalCode
children.description: Approval Code of a transaction Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:632563 Allowable Values: 6

children.name: PostingReference
children.description: Posting reference (Like -Transaction Posted Successfully) Allowable Values: 50

children.name: InternalResponseCode
children.description: Response code generated by Corecard application for internal identification in transaction processing. Allowable Values: 50

children.name: RetrievalReferenceNumber
children.description: Unique identification number captured in request used for identification of transaction. Allowable Values: 12

children.name: SystemTraceAuditNumber
children.description: Unique identification number captured in request used for identification of transaction.

children.name: AuthStatus
children.description: Autorization Status Valid Values:Decline , Partial Approve, Approve Example:Decline , Partial Approve, Approve Allowable Values: 5

children.name: CalculatedOTB
children.description: Calculated Open to Buy Amount Valid Values:500.00 Format:XXX.XX Example:500.00

children.name: AdminNumber
children.description: Details can be obtained by admin number (Embossing Acctid) Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: TranType
children.description: Type of transaction like purchase,Cash withdrawel etc. Allowable Values: 5

children.name: PurgeDate
children.description: Date after which transaction will not be displayed in return of serch requests.

children.name: TranCodeInternal
children.description: Transaction code generated by Corecard application. Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TransactionAmount
children.description: Transaction Amount. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXX.XX Example:200.00

children.name: InvoiceNumber
children.description: User entered identification number captured in request and echoed in response. Allowable Values: 28

children.name: CreditPlanMaster
children.description: Plan name associated with the card account. Valid Values:A-Z, 0-9 Format:XXXXXX Example:6 Months No Interest if Paid in Full Allowable Values: 20

children.name: TransactionID
children.description: Transaction Number for transaction being posted. Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example:23654789

children.name: DateTimeLocalTransaction
children.description: Date time of the system when transaction was initiated.

children.name: CardSequenceNumber
children.description: This tag reflects the Sequence Number of the Card. Valid Values: 0-9 Example: 1
